column1: If you later automate (Python/Node), write game & player stats into Results and Player_Stats.
• Use an MLB stats provider API to pull scheduled games, box scores, and player game logs.
• Map each game to your GameID (same format used in Games/Results).
• Write team totals and SP lines into Results.
• Write per-player batting/pitching lines into Player_Stats.
• Refresh the workbook to update scores.
